g.text: POST /ai/inline with the selection and the action
Read and grant the daily allowance
Build the prompt from the action, the selection
Preview the suggestion as it arrives
End of stream and tokens consumed
Record the interaction and decrement the balance
Apply the edit to the captured range
The range is captured once, before the stream starts. Reading
the selection again after the stream let any click or blur move
it, so "Replace" could silently overwrite different text.
